review_points: reminder and failed delivery use consume-o4/emit-o3+o4 loops whose termination lives in guards or SML; written here as repeatable and bounded before pay order / package delivered

CPN forces pick item < create package per item; the 66 backward votes are all equal-timestamp ties (checked 2026-08-27: zero strictly-earlier cases), and the export preserves no within-tie firing order (document order is activity-grouped, numeric id suffixes are per-activity counters). Def. orders discards ties, so the log lens orders the pair and agrees with the CPN; only the index-voting Python oracle misreads it
